import json, os
import psycopg

url = os.getenv('APP_DB_URL', '').strip()
print('PROFILE_DB_URL', bool(url))
if not url:
    raise SystemExit(1)

with psycopg.connect(url) as conn:
    with conn.cursor() as cur:
        cur.execute("""
        with base as (
            select
              lower(coalesce(j.user_name,'')) as user_name,
              length(coalesce(ji.response_json,'')) as resp_len,
              ji.status
            from job_items ji
            join jobs j on j.job_id = ji.job_id
            where lower(coalesce(j.user_name,'')) in ('admin','admin2')
        )
        select
          user_name,
          count(*)::bigint as total_rows,
          round(avg(resp_len)::numeric,2) as avg_resp_len,
          max(resp_len) as max_resp_len,
          sum(case when status in ('QUEUED','PROCESSING') then 1 else 0 end)::bigint as pending_rows,
          sum(case when status = 'FAILED' then 1 else 0 end)::bigint as failed_rows
        from base
        group by user_name
        order by total_rows desc
        """)
        prof = [
            {
                'user_name': r[0],
                'total_rows': int(r[1]),
                'avg_response_json_len': float(r[2]) if r[2] is not None else None,
                'max_response_json_len': int(r[3]) if r[3] is not None else None,
                'pending_rows': int(r[4]),
                'failed_rows': int(r[5]),
            }
            for r in cur.fetchall()
        ]
        print('SUMMARY_PROFILE', json.dumps(prof))

print('PROFILE_DONE')
